title: cistus fasciculatus
intro: Cistus fasciculatus, commonly known as Rock Rose or Jersey Tea, is a flowering plant species in the family Cistaceae. It is a low-growing, woody shrub native to the Mediterranean region, valued for its medicinal properties and ornamental value. The health benefits of Cistus fasciculatus include its potential to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and diterpenes, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
